units: <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 1">Ruth R. to I, 19</cite> <he>לפרה הדיוטית … ואמר ר׳ היא וכ׳</he> like a common cow whom her owner exhibits in the market, saying, she is a ploughing cow and makes even furrows; <he>אמרין אין ר׳ אילין מִכְוָותָה וכ׳</he> (not <he>מכרתיה</he>) if she be a gentle cow, what do these her burns (scabs) mean?; Yalk. ib. 601 <he>רודייניס</he> (corr. acc. the entire passage).
